name: Monarch phenotype bridge
connection_basis: ClinVar condition to HPO to Monarch UPheno or MHMI HPO-MP to MGI allele, constrained by 1:1 orthology

name: Ortholog-first phenotype evidence
connection_basis: 1:1 ortholog first, then ClinVar or significant GWAS phenotype evidence compared with MGI MP and allele-name evidence
interpretation: Candidate correspondence with within-tier support B or C; B is an exact normalized label and C a lexical hypothesis. Manual human literature phenotypes and support A are disabled.

name: Curated disease model
connection_basis: Exact OMIM identifier shared by a supported ClinVar condition and an MGI-curated mouse disease model, constrained by 1:1 orthology
interpretation: Disease-model-level candidate correspondence independent of the HPO-MP bridge
